evals.prompt: 把我们项目里的这个 SFC 组件改写成 defineComponent + TSX 写法：它有一个 count 的 props（默认 0），点击按钮时 emit increment 事件，模板里用 v-if/v-for 渲染一个列表。给出改写后的完整组件。
evals.expected_output: defineComponent() + setup() returning a render function/JSX; props declared with type + default; emits declared and dispatched via emit(); no <script setup> remains.
expectations: Component uses defineComponent() from 'vue' with a setup() function returning JSX / a render function
No <script setup> or SFC template remains — the output is TSX
Props are declared with explicit types (type + default)
The increment event is declared in emits and dispatched via emit('increment')

evals.prompt: 写一个 TSX 的搜索输入组件：输入时防抖 300ms 后 emit search 事件，组件卸载时要清理定时器；用 watch 或 watchEffect 实现都可以。
evals.expected_output: defineComponent + TSX; watcher (watch or watchEffect) with a 300ms debounce; cleanup in onUnmounted/onWatcherCleanup; emits declared.
expectations: Debounces the input by ~300ms before emitting search
Cleans up the timer/watcher on unmount (onUnmounted / onBeforeUnmount / watch cleanup)
The search event is declared in emits and dispatched via emit('search')

evals.prompt: 写一个 TSX 的表格组件：接收 1 万行的数据 props，只读展示，行内不需要编辑；表头配置和行数据都会变化。注意性能，并说明你为什么这样选响应式 API。
evals.expected_output: Avoids deep-reactive wrappers for the large read-only data (props directly, or shallowRef/markRaw for local copies), with a stated performance rationale.
expectations: Avoids unnecessary deep reactivity for the large read-only list (uses props directly, shallowRef, or markRaw)
Briefly explains the performance rationale for choosing shallow reactivity
